name: Dang Deck
summary: Phase one: structural repair and deck rebuild
description: The beam under the old deck had rotted through, and it was also holding up the corner of the house, which had already sagged. We replaced the beam and posts and brought the corner back to level. This is phase one, and we're helping the owners plan what comes next, so the deck was built with the following phases already in mind.
scope: Structural beam replacement, house corner levelled, deck rebuild, stairs, railings
